negatives.sentence: First written 15 November 2026, said again twice on 16 November and once on 17 November (04:06 WIB, from the clock), and corrected in three places on the morning of 18 November and again that afternoon, when "We are far from it" was rewritten from readers' reports on the account's chapters; on 19 November two passages of "We are far from it" were changed (the lock and a needed level; what is not there), after one AI writer's paper, eight AI readers and searches on small numbers, with no Lean written.

Two AI readers who took no part set a first form of the two passages, one against the Lean's statements and one against the reports, and found five places that said something false or more than its source; the passages were rewritten, and a third set the second form against both and found no such place in the passages, one in this note's count of readers, and eleven lesser ones; what was changed after it was in its words and was not read again until 20 November.

On 20 November one sentence was added to "What is not there" from that day's record of a try by program, with no Lean written; one AI reader had rebuilt the course's numbers without seeing the writer's program.

That day too, at Ren's "Yes, the table", a table was made of 89 places in the repository by eight properties that the writer fixed beforehand, two AI readers a group who did not see each other and a third where they differed (69 of 712 cells), from statements and not proofs; from it one paragraph was added at the head of "We are far from it", the first sentence of "What is not there" was changed, and five sentences elsewhere were narrowed to the package.

Two AI readers who took no part then checked the note and the change, one against the data file and the Lean of the place with all eight, the other against this page and the note read whole: the counts are as the data file has them; between them eleven places in the paragraph, the changed sentence and the note said something false or more than the table shows (among them: a place in the package that has the three by the table's letters was not named; a join was told as not found that was not looked for; a supplied law of revision was told as derived; nothing in the place reads the capacity it was told as using up), and twenty were lesser.

The four with what multiplies and the last two (chapter 2 §9, §10) have no level that can run down; of the seven with what multiplies on a level, none has the last two together, and one, chapter 5 §12's rule rebuilt from its members, has the rule set again from a count ("What is not there" below).
No join of the package to `PopulationCorrection` was looked for beyond a search by name, which found none.
The first sentence of this section and the first of "What is not there" were set against the table; the rest was written before it, and where it lists what each piece has the table has more places.
No theorem was found that states the two classes in amounts on a general record.

A first look on 18 November at the 68 theorems that name one of three classes of a single step (20 of them by three AI readers, the other 48 by one) and at parts of about thirty of the package's 406 files found no general statement that a course passes from being within renewal to breaking or undermining.
The chapter calls this near-definitional; the group, the courses still open and what is kept are handed in, and which way a reading in time turns the course is not stated there.

*What is not there.* No statement that was found in the package has all three together with each doing work: units that each need a level and leave offspring, a rule set again from their share, and that level as what they need (outside the package, by the table's cells: one place with all eight of its properties, where slots revise and leave no offspring and no slot needs a level; and five files of the market model and two programs with what multiplies, a level that can run down and a rule set again from a share, where in the market what multiplies is a share that grows; the cells were read, not those files' statements).

A course was found by program, in a model that is not in the Lean: what multiplies under the favouring rule draws the level below the need of the unit the rule counts, that unit leaves nothing, the rule set again no longer favours, and the rest goes on where with the rule held it ends.

A candidate condition for when such a way never ends was searched on small numbers, and read on paper by one reader who found no false step, one half read classically, and is not proved; by that reader the lock does not do the joining in it, and the fall's reaching the rule is not in it ([the record](research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/dj-a-line-on-a-stock/reads-2026-11-19/NOTE.md)).
No theorem states any sentence of them whole (below, "Of a reading").*
We take this to be the third paragraph's sentence that what is being used up may be exactly what makes no difference; that is our interpretation, and no theorem states it.

- *What the understanding says and no module states:* twelve things, among them holding to something as a going-on (every held-to is handed in; the two reported exceptions are a goal formed from feedback on a supplied construction, and one valuation kept as state whose update is handed in); an account that comes true because many act on it; narrowing joined to taking; and the taking and the closing as outcomes of one course in general (in the one general theorem with both, both are premises; in one built course, `Habitat`, the clearing is the act its design assigns to the line's reading, and the removal of the dweller's line, read there as the habitat's reader, comes about on the course those acts generate; the selection in it is by persistence, and the chapter says nothing ties the readers to it, [07 §4.12](../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#r-a-selection-removing-its-read

The level of the law before is written the same way, a take added to a level below which giving falls short of it; no statement was found that says the two are one point, and no other theorem in the package uses this law.

*What the first step found, the same evening.* It did not come out: no statement was found that places the two ways with respect to each other (the second way taken only as staying within what is made again, the first of three senses told apart on 17 November), by eight tests written down first and an AI agent set to refute ([the record](research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/dj-a-line-on-a-stock/meeting-2026-11-20/NOTE.md) has what was asked, how each guess came out, what is kept, and what a checker who took no part changed in it).

On paper and with nothing built: the renewal files' "renewable" is the package's "keepable" with three fields re-packed (both agents, at the definitions; the lemma not written); by that, the agent set to refute finds, no named law of either side becomes a case of a law of the other or gets shorter; by other routes three lemmas of the renewal files are instances of general laws of the package, none shorter and none a law about renewal; what the relation places is some run keeping a guard against none, which says nothing of selecting (both agents); and, by the agent set to refute, no statement that could be written without a new model was found that says where a course passes from the one way to the other.

*Two words for no return, set against each other (21 November).* The package says in two ways that a course can no longer be kept, and no module was found that has both: recoverable, of a course of levels with the feasible courses handed in, on which the lock's point of no return and a loss read in time stand; and keepable, of a state of a process, on which keeping several conditions together stands.
That read said that one rule from the present reading over more than one step, and keeping for ever by a choice made from a reading, were not found.

Chapter 8's table of what a response takes in already sets the lock under two of the response's inputs, the timing of the reading and its revision, as a telling; no theorem stating the lock as a case of the response's law was found.

The writer's reading, which no report states whole: the two halves of the idea's sentence are stated in two kinds of model, and no law of the first kind was found with a level that runs down, though built cases have one, while the second has no moves in the seven modules read.

They placed nothing either, and they are the links of that kind that exist; they are in scratch, not in the package.) Each came back, by a reader who took no part or by the read itself, as a dictionary or as two sides with no theorem between them.

A read of 21 November by four capped AI readers, each alone, with questions fixed beforehand ([the record](research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/dj-a-line-on-a-stock/read-registering-2026-11-21/NOTE.md), with what a checker who took no part changed in it), did not find it met in three of its four groups and left it undecided for one law: in what was read, no reading changes itself with nothing handed in, and no fall in what a going-on rests on causes a new registering without the reading of it handed in.
The readers found no general statement that joins a line that multiplies to any of them (fourteen reads in part, one of them a sweep of the heads of the modules' opening accounts).

Chapter 2 §10 has the last two in one model and compares when the readers read with when they are removed ([there](../theories/becoming/chapters/02-MAP.md#r-the-lock-draws-its-readers-out)); chapter 7 §3.6 sets the first against a reader's earliest reading; no statement was found that compares all three.

**No statement was found that places the two ways with respect to each other.** That is the refuting agent's verdict, and I take it: none has both ends, the edge between them, and what a course passes by.
Not found by the lock's worker or the refuter; in units the sign of the difference in use did no work in any statement found, so there was nothing for it to have as cases.

**Not found in the Lean, in what the reader against the Lean read** (its report lists the lines; a search by the ideas' words across the package, opening accounts and statements, not proofs): a module that joins `RuleShaping`'s return with a level (the modules that cite `RuleShaping` use neither `RegimeMargin` nor `TurningInTime`); a lock whose favoured kind draws less; an offspring number that depends on the level otherwise than through a need; an exact law for a kid whose need is higher than its parent's (the module's account says there is no exact condition for kids that take more or less; of a higher need it says nothing directly, and `HigherStartEnds` shows the fate is not monotone in the start level).

The frozen file's addition asked that no statement have a lock ending in every case, against October's evaluator-succession experiment (appointing by success did better while demand stayed stable, worse after it shifted).

The record of 17 November tells its own frozen file as saying that where what a going-on rests on is one amount standing apart, a going-on that remakes it "is not sayable", an argument from the model's definitions carried by no theorem; today it was tried from the other side, with a return and a rule, and nothing was found against it.

Whether a small Lean statement is worth having from today is open and nothing is written before Ren has seen this: the nearest would be the check that the family's step keeps the order where the favoured draw less, which, by the refuter's unread argument (the second of the three not found as one statement by the reader), would make this family a case of generic laws: a recognition, not a join; and U2, of which `two_units_iff` and the scratch's `mixed_turns_iff` would be cases, which is a join of the smaller kind.
The agent that the 19:36 addition added after the four, to set surviving statements against the table's other rows, was not run: no statement survived as a meeting.
So the widened test 2 was applied to no statement: none of the four set any statement against those rows, and the reader read only the opening accounts of some of them.
- **U2 is not in the package**, in other names or as a case of a law that is there with nothing left over (not found in what was read).

The Lean has, with that premise, only that what is kept whatever the moves is kept for every number of steps by some moves (`GuardHorizon.kernel_viable`); no theorem from `Kernel` to `Keepable` was found.
The refuting reader found no error.
I found no theorem that says that of them; one reader adds that the two sets follow from laws the Lean has, not written out.

"some course keeps it" is "the standstill held from here keeps" in 267,313 of the 267,598; 285 are not, and no statement that was read gives the innermost region (532 configurations are kept by each rule held and not by every switching between them).
The refuting reader: no law of November is about that, and it is where comparing courses has content.
On these courses the readings (marks, windows, the lock's share) are given; no statement is over a choice among readings, or over a class of starts.
The record of 17 November found the third's last clause in no law, only in built examples.

A reader of 18 November already set chapter 5 §12, chapter 7 §5, chapter 4 §5 and chapter 4 §8 against the direction and found none of the four a theorem placing the two ways where a line multiplies or a rule is read again from its share; of chapter 5 §10 it found the lock pointed to, not stated.
Negatives are "not found in what was read", and each report lists what it read.

- **"Already there"** (a general law that states, exactly, when goings-on that pass along what comes from beyond them go on without end): not found in the package by any of the three readers of the package.
"no law found derives going on from amounts, levels or a stock"; the third finds it false only if one keeper and the level it keeps count as goings-on resting on each other.
A sufficient general law where what is given is taken from a giver's own standing was not found by the third reader in what it read.

`Web.Dependent` runs one way, from active to supported, so no law in what it read concludes, from support, that a formation is active or gives; what is concluded is that an embodied relatum arises only as an active formation gives to it, and that a dependent is active only while what it bears on is.
I find in the reports no statement with a keeper that keeps at a cost to itself, from a source that is said, with its going on concluded; no reader was asked that as such.

The next step I take, then: read the eight renewal files' statements against `ReadOffInTime` (November) and `Viability` (October), and against the direction page's own words, to say whether that relation is there, is a renaming, or is not there.
Negatives are "not found in what was read"; each report lists what it read.

- **Why the renewable stretch is not the second way and its end not the first**, by the files' own theorems, searches and README, as the refuter assembled them: a history can lie in the renewable stretch and form nothing; renewability is then lost with the reserve unchanged; nothing in the eight files selects; no deadline after the loss was found, in the declaration lists of the eight files, for a law that has a population; and that a configuration is renewable or not is not found decided in the renewal files (their README lists an exact characterization of renewable configurations as not yet proved).

Not found stated: that a guard is keepable from a configuration exactly where it holds there and some step leads to one it is keepable from; and that where every step keeps the guard's complement, every step keeps not being keepable.

**The pieces lie on opposite sides, and what would have to be new is five things** (the refuter, with where the package has each): a rule and a share for a policy on which kinds are formed (the construction of a policy exists for any process; for this law there is no rule and its order, no share, no `f` and `h` as functions, and no proofs of the lock's three premises); a cost of supporting borne by the supporter (none found on either side; the package has a cost of using a level); a finite source (the package has one level with a cap and its giving handed in); a selection among histories (the package has it on courses of levels only, all supplied); and a decision of whether a configuration is renewable (not proved in the renewal files; the package has it for one level).
Negatives are "not found in what was read".
- **New kinds were not found.** Births are taken within the kind (a premise);
- **Of continuing through change widening what can go on after:** the second and third readers found no law.
No law read concludes an opening in time from premises that are not already a going-on, a rise, or nothing lost.
No law read joins that comparison to the law above, or either to the grammar's generation in descent.
A chain that gains two points and loses one at every step has more and more and does not keep widening in the Lean; no statement of "more" in that looser sense is in this note.

Four AI readers (run as Claude Opus by the run's record), one group of places each and each alone, capped at 45 tool calls (26, not stated, 28 and 30 by their own counts), answered six questions fixed beforehand, from statements, docstrings and opening accounts; the second opened no proof, the first and fourth opened none except where an extracted statement or a definition stood in for one, and the third skipped proofs except where it says otherwise; each report says what was read only by name.
Negatives are "not found in what was read".
"No law was found in which the loss or fall itself triggers the reading." The second, of one module:

One more, from this row's own record and not from these readers (the coordinating session's reminder): in the course of 19 November, found by program in a model that is not in the Lean, the level reached the rule through the need of the unit the rule counts, which left nothing; the rule then no longer favoured.
The item as the page words it was not found met in three of the four groups, and the first reader left it undecided for one law.
No law read has a reading change itself with nothing handed in, and none has a fall in what a going-on rests on cause a new registering without the reading of it handed in.

The writer of this note then read the module whole, and mended three sentences of its header comment after the second reader's findings (one of them shown false by it); no statement or proof was changed, and the module was built once more (build 6: exit 0, an empty axiom report, 37 theorems).
The package says that a course can no longer be kept in two places, and no module, result record or chapter line was found that has both.

Under its line "After": four points of the coordinating session, taken in as tests, and the survey session's search, which found no place with both, each written there as before any report was read; and what the first reader found ([its report](read-older-and-already-stated.md.txt)), entered at 16:47, which by the clock was before the worker began.
That reader found no join in the Lean it read.
That it comes back only where the guard was broken is not stated in the module.
It is not stated on the package's `Recoverable`, and the second reader says that given `j1` it follows by rewriting.

- **J2's first clause holds.** Its clause that a point exists holds with an added premise, keepability decided along the run, for a family of J1's form; it is not stated on the package's `NoReturnAt`.
(c), a step law, is proved for any family of J1's form and not stated on the package's `Recoverable`.
It is filed as that … and no module is proposed for the package" has as its condition that J1 to J3 and J5 hold, which is not met.

I file it all the same as a dictionary with one bridge, and propose no module for the package, because of what the second reader showed: the twins put keepable in and take it out again, on a process where keepable carries no choice, and the law before them does the work.
Not stated: that a point exists, on the package's `NoReturnAt`.

Under its line "After", written while the readers ran and before any report was read: the coordinating session's search, which found no place where this side was read against the lock; that this row's read of 16 November had left this side out by name; and the writer's glance at chapter 3's own lock.
- **"Nothing new"** (C6: three carriers once more, no theorem joining any two): not as worded.
Its converse was not found.

**One rule from the present reading, over more than one step: not found.** `GuardHorizon.uniform_viable` (406) gives one step further from a rule whose move is admissible for `n` more steps at every configuration, at a configuration within the guard; only the first move comes from the reading, and the later ones are chosen configuration by configuration.
So the frozen file's C2 is partly false as worded: the uniform policy is not stated over a closed set and not for ever (the second reader).

Over steps: in the built case `Matching`, two starts are kept for two steps where the step keeps a bit and not where it keeps nothing (`keeping_matters`, 435); that each start alone is kept there is not stated.
An exact law of it was not found.
No statement joining either to `KeptFor` or to the common response was found.
No module in this group puts the reading and the steps in one statement."

- **A seam between two ways of keeping over steps.** No theorem joins `KeptFor` to `GuardHorizon.Viable` or to the uniform policy (the second reader).
The Lean has a way to make a law with moves into a process (`Viability.disturbed`, with `GuardHorizon.dViable_iff`, 230); no statement applies it to the lock's models (the second reader).

So the chapters place the lock under two inputs of a response, in a table; no theorem stating the lock as a case of the response's law was found in the seven modules or by the coordinating session's search of names.

- **C1 holds** in what was read (the first reader; the second supports it for `GuardHorizon`'s law at 341 and `OpenedCorrection.correctable_iff`, and did not read chapter 3's own law beyond its telling): chapter 3's law is exact for one choice of act, given a choice over the readings; the relational form is exact with no choice (the first reader's alone); it was not found stated for keeping a guard for ever.
- **C6 is not as worded**: joins among these places exist, two seams are drawn more exactly, and no join to the lock was found.

The reader's verdict has two qualifiers: the second, fourth and fifth guesses hold as worded, "the last for the two readings named"; and the counter-guess's clause that no law of the package does work is "false only in small part".

- **The horizon is idle.** Holding always keeps, so admissible for `n` steps more comes, for every `n`, to the next level not being zero (the reader, from `closed_above` and `viable_above`; not stated as one theorem).
